newsitem.title: POLAND: Warsaw bourse expected to extend gains.
newsitem.headline: Warsaw bourse expected to extend gains.

text.p: Polish shares were expected to extend gains following Friday's strong buying after price fixing and stronger performance of most stocks in continuous trade than in the earlier main session.
Analysts said the bourse was likely to recover from an earlier 2.2 percent fall, but said its upside was limited in the longer-term by the pressure from current and forthcoming large privatisations.
